notes: 智能体 follows the zh-CN locale call; 通行密钥 and 通行密钥请求 match the existing webauthn_chooser terms.
Safety claim intact: 暂时无法使用通行密钥 (not available yet) / 计划支持 Touch ID 通行密钥 (planned, no date or promise) / 改用系统浏览器. Message says 可能正在等待 (may be waiting), never 失败/已答复.

The 请 in 目前请改用系统浏览器 follows this namespace's established imperative convention: 28 of 247 ui.browser strings and 442 strings catalogue-wide render instructional copy with 请 where the English has no 'please'. Recorded as corpus-consistent, not a defect.
Full sentences keep 。; the short labels (关闭通行密钥提示 / 在系统浏览器中打开 / 通行密钥请求) are unpunctuated, per the guide.
